shortdesc.ph: Reasons for poor experience quality when the local user receives remote audio streams.
Reasons why the QoE of the local user when receiving a remote audio stream is poor.

plentry.pd: (0): No issue, indicates good experience quality for the local user.
(1): Poor network quality of the remote user.
(2): Poor network quality of the local user.
(4): Weak Wi-Fi or cellular signal of the local user.
(8): Wi-Fi and Bluetooth are enabled simultaneously on the local user’s device, causing signal interference and degraded audio transmission quality.
0: No reason, indicating a good QoE of the local user.
1: The remote user's network quality is poor.
2: The local user's network quality is poor.
4: The local user's Wi-Fi or mobile network signal is weak.
8: The local user enables both Wi-Fi and bluetooth, and their signals interfere with each other. As a result, audio transmission quality is undermined.
